strategies.name: Gotobi Fix
strategies.rule: Long 03:00 Tokyo → 09:55, short 09:55 → 10:30 on 5/10/15/20/25/last day (prev. bank day).
strategies.note: Replicated vendor CASE01. +$175K 2012–26 at 1 lot ×3. Units: normalised R (1 = avg 2012–19 day).
strategies.entry: Long USDJPY, EURJPY and GBPJPY at 03:00 Tokyo on gotobi days (5th, 10th, 15th, 20th, 25th, last day; moved to the previous Japanese bank day).
strategies.exit: Close the long at 09:55 Tokyo and go short until 10:30 Tokyo.

strategies.name: RDM
strategies.rule: 09:45: if 09:00→09:45 move disagrees with yesterday's RTH candle, trade today's direction to 15:55. Skip FOMC.
strategies.note: Born in the theory factory (2.48M theories, 142 real vs 2 placebo). Units: normalised R.
strategies.entry: At 09:45 New York: if (09:45 open - 09:00 open) has the opposite sign of yesterday's RTH candle (09:30 open to 16:00 close), enter in today's direction.

strategies.name: RDM 1:10
strategies.rule: RDM entry, stop 0.15 × ATR(14 sessions), target 10R, flat 15:55. Cost 1 pt.
strategies.note: Pine: rdm_convex.pine. 20% win, avg winner 5.1R, worst losing streak 34. Random-direction null median +0.16R.
strategies.entry: RDM signal at 09:45 New York, entry at the 09:45 open.
strategies.exit: Stop 0.15 x ATR(14 sessions); target 10R; flat 15:55. Stop first when both touch in one bar.

strategies.name: RDM Runner
strategies.rule: RDM entry, stop 0.25 × ATR, break-even at +2R then 2R trail, flat 15:55.
strategies.note: Fixed 10R at 0.25 ATR scored +0.28R OOS (t 3.3, p 0.005); trail variant shown.
strategies.exit: Stop 0.25 x ATR; break-even at +2R, then trail 2R behind the best price; flat 15:55.

strategies.name: AVP Equation
strategies.rule: AVP signal taken only if ridge E[R] > 0 (9 features, fit 2012–19).
strategies.entry: AVP LVN rejection (close back out of a low-volume node of the 5-session composite profile), taken only if the ridge equation predicts E[R] > 0.
strategies.exit: Stop beyond the zone's far edge (2 points), target 2R, flat at the next session open.

strategies.name: Pluto Sequence
strategies.rule: Divide-by-4 time quarters, liquidity sweep entries.

strategies.name: SP Model v8
strategies.rule: London range sweep → NY reversal. 00–06 and 02:00–09:30 windows.
strategies.entry: London range (00:00-06:00) swept, then a New York reversal setup (S1/S2/S3); limit entry at fib 0.5 or 0.588 chosen by the value-area position.
strategies.exit: Stop at fib 0.702 / 0.816, target at fib 0.267 / 0.36; flat 14:00.

strategies.name: SP Model v8 · London 02:00
strategies.rule: SP v8 with the London range 02:00-09:30.
strategies.entry: Same rules as SP Model v8 with the London range 02:00-09:30.
strategies.exit: Stop at fib 0.702 / 0.816, target at fib 0.267 / 0.36; flat 14:00.

strategies.name: AVP Zones
strategies.rule: Composite 5-session profile, LVN rejection, 2R. Exact Pine port, real volume.
strategies.note: 540-setting grid: 0 pass. Aug–Nov 2026 positive window reproduced, 14 years negative.
strategies.entry: Close back above an LVN top after a wick into it (mirror for shorts); one signal per zone per side per session.
strategies.exit: Stop beyond the zone's far edge (2 points), target 2R, flat at the next session open.

strategies.rule: CPI / PPI / NFP / FOMC drift and fade.
strategies.note: Only useful as a filter: skip FOMC for RDM.

strategies.rule: Overnight range split in 4, quarter levels as targets.

strategies.name: Layers 13M (FVG multi-TF)
strategies.rule: D/4H/1H gap → touch → 15m confirm → 1m entry → stop → target × 960 filters = 13,271,040 strategies.
strategies.note: 17 survivors vs 22 for random zones; 1 of 17 positive in 2022–26. Daily gaps beat random levels by ~0.1R, still ~0 after costs.
